jobs.title: Financial Investment Analyst (Remote)
jobs.description:
Role
: Financial Investment Analyst (Remote)
Location
: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job
Type
: Contract
Payout
: $154 - $210/hour

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Financial Investment Analyst to work on a contract basis. This role involves analyzing financial data, evaluating investment opportunities, and supporting strategic financial decisions. The position requires expertise in investment principles and financial modeling.

Key Responsibilities:

• Analyze financial statements and market trends to assess investment viability.
• Prepare detailed reports on financial performance and investment recommendations.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align investment strategies with business objectives.
• Monitor portfolio performance and provide insights on risk and return metrics.
• Conduct due diligence on potential investment opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Proficiency in financial modeling and valuation techniques is required.
• Experience with investment analysis and portfolio management is required.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail are required.
• Knowledge of financial markets and economic indicators is required.
• Ability to interpret complex financial data and present findings clearly is required.

More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the financial services industry, contributing to data-driven investment decisions. The contract position provides flexibility and exposure to high-impact financial projects.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Description We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Financial Analyst to support financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and business decision-making. The role focuses on analyzing financial and operational data, preparing management reports, developing financial models, monitoring performance, and providing actionable insights to support business objectives.
Key responsibilities include preparing budgets, forecasts, financial reports, variance analyses, management summaries, and financial models. The Financial Analyst will analyze revenue, costs, expenses, margins, profitability, cash flow, and key performance indicators to identify trends, performance gaps, risks, and opportunities.
The role will work closely with finance, accounting, sales, operations, procurement, supply chain, and business teams to collect and validate financial information and understand key business drivers. Responsibilities may include supporting monthly and quarterly reporting cycles, analyzing actual versus budget performance, maintaining forecasting models, preparing business cases, and supporting financial planning activities.
The Financial Analyst will also provide analytical support to management by translating complex financial and operational information into clear insights and recommendations. The role will investigate discrepancies, validate data, improve reporting accuracy, and support financial controls and decision-making processes.
The position contributes to continuous improvement by enhancing financial models, reporting processes, analytical tools, and forecasting methodologies. Strong analytical, numerical, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills are essential, together with high attention to detail, commercial awareness, and sound financial judgment.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, financial modeling, and performance measurement.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to analyze revenue, costs, expenses, margins, profitability, cash flow, budgets, forecasts, and financial variances.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or equivalent spreadsheet tools, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and financial analysis functions.
Good understanding of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
Familiarity with ERP, FP&A, accounting, financial planning, business intelligence, or reporting systems is an advantage.
Ability to prepare financial reports, forecasts, budgets, variance analyses, management presentations, and business cases.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify key financial and operational drivers.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-financial stakeholders.
Good organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple reporting cycles, analyses, and deadlines.
High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial and business information.
Proactive, responsible, analytical, commercially aware, adaptable, collaborative, detail-oriented, and committed to financial accuracy and continuous improvement.
